$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: Default story: The Team navigation link indicates selected/current state using background color alone, with no icon, text styling, border, or pattern change to also convey the state.
Control boundaries, icons, and focus rings are clearly distinguishable from backgrounds in both light and dark modes.
All visible control text (Dashboard, Team, Settings, Search, Notifications) matches the announced names from the screen reader.
No text is cut off, overlapping, or truncated; all content is fully readable.
Default focused story: Dashboard link has a prominent, rounded blue border outline that is immediately obvious and highly contrasting.
